description: Amazon CloudWatch Logs metadata connector (Tier-3, no-row-data). Indexes log-group metadata only — log-group name, ARN, retention, stored bytes, creation time, metric-filter count, and an optional stream count + last-event timestamp — via the AWS CLI's CloudWatch Logs describe commands. Never fetches log-event contents / row data: there is no get-log-events, no filter-log-events, no start-query, no get-query-results, and no tail. Reuses the existing AWS credentials via the aws CLI. Read-only; no write tools.
author: Nimbus
